concept: Security Hub: aggregate and prioritize security findings across accounts
tests: Which service continuously aggregates and prioritizes findings (public buckets, overly permissive IAM policies) across all accounts.
expected: AWS Security Hub integrated with GuardDuty, Config, IAM Access Analyzer — a single prioritized view of security posture. Triggers: "across all accounts", "continuously", "findings prioritized".
why_not: Config alone records configuration but doesn't aggregate/prioritize cross-service findings; Macie — sensitive data in S3; Trusted Advisor — limited checks.
